operating_characteristics.source: OPERATING-CHARACTERISTICS-v5.md, design-search/oc_v5.py, 2000 simulated studies per cell
operating_characteristics.design: N = 1 x 12 windows, N = 12 x 3 windows, 90 min each; degrade: N = 12 x 2

outcomes.statement: Finished work bends below proportional: per-agent finished output at N = 12 is lower than at N = 1
outcomes.rule: one-sided NB likelihood-ratio test of gamma < 0 in finished ~ theta x slot-hours x N^gamma (CV 0.3 fixed); BEND iff p < 0.05
outcomes.note: per-agent ratio N = 12 : 1 = 0.35 (95% 0.22-0.57), p = 1.62e-05; simulated false-alarm rate under linear truth 0.03, power 0.91 under Amdahl (alpha 0.1), 1.00 under USL, 0.26 against a mild bend (alpha 0.03)

outcomes.statement: SCALE without the windows that ran out of tasks more than 10 min before their end (reported beside SCALE)
outcomes.note: no window ran out of tasks more than 10 min before its end: identical to SCALE

outcomes.statement: Collisions force rework: a change's first merge-queue pass fails (rebase conflict or integration failure) more often the more other changes merged since its base
outcomes.rule: logistic collided ~ j (merges of other changes since the change's launch or last rework message), one-sided LR p < 0.05 -> DETECTED
outcomes.note: OR per merge since base 0.881, one-sided p = 0.727; p-hat 0.0000 (95% 0.0000-0.0085); 4 collisions in 239 passes; simulated false-alarm rate 0.02, power 0.28 at p = 0.005, 0.52 at p = 0.01, 0.83 at p = 0.02, 0.98 at p = 0.05 with USL-like workers; 0.83 at p = 0.005, 0.98 at p = 0.01, 1.00 at p = 0.02 with linear workers

outcomes.statement: The escape rate rises with fleet size (N = 1 to 12)
outcomes.rule: logistic escaped ~ (N - 1) / (N_max - 1) over approvals with a hidden-test result, one-sided LR p < 0.05; >= 8 escapes

outcomes.statement: The escape rate: approved changes that fail their hidden tests on the approved head (the verifier's ceiling)
outcomes.rule: estimate with Wilson and task-clustered 95% intervals; integration failures are the collision channel (COLL)

outcomes.statement: Which rival fits best (linear, Amdahl, USL, Carnot uncapped), each with a free level
outcomes.rule: highest NB likelihood; reported with the simulated confusion matrix (USL and Carnot differ by (1 - p)^(N-1), about 6% at N = 12 with p = 0.005, so they are not separated)
outcomes.note: order usl (-43.97) > carnot (-44.18) > amdahl (-44.48) > linear (-52.32); three-way: usl-carnot; linear vs bending: bending (log LR linear - best bent -8.35)

outcomes.statement: Where the limit moves: reviewer and merge-queue utilisation at N = 12
outcomes.rule: reported; a reviewer busy >= 50% of an N_high window is 'approaching', >= 80% 'saturating' (then SCALE may reflect review as well as the workers)
outcomes.note: N = 1: reviewer 0.06 (max 0.12), merge queue 0.008, review 20 s, V 181/h; N = 12: reviewer 0.24 (max 0.27), merge queue 0.019, review 20 s, V 179/h

outcomes.statement: H3: collisions come from changes sharing a file (jm, given j)
outcomes.rule: logistic collided ~ j + jm, one-sided LR p for jm

outcomes.statement: Study 1's H1 under control: collisions vs k (changes in flight at first submit) and m
outcomes.rule: logistic collided ~ k + m, one-sided LR p for k

outcomes.statement: Per-size lambda (first submissions per slot-hour), completion, timeouts, start-up, rework wait
outcomes.note: N = 1: lambda 6.56, completion 0.93, timeouts 2, start-up 1.40 min; N = 12: lambda 2.60, completion 0.82, timeouts 52, start-up 1.38 min
